usage: Type is the film's voice — no more default-single-family output. tools/fetch_font.py pulls OFL fonts from google/fonts at pin. Pairings below are STARTING points; check_project (full mode) requires style.json.type_system to name display+body roles, size ladder, and what is deliberately broken.
laws: size ladder >= 1.5x between hierarchy levels; ONE deliberate break per film, noted in style.json.broken_rules
one display + one body + one mono/numeric max; a third family needs a written reason
weight contrast is the default emphasis tool (900 vs 300), not color or glow
Arabic display at >= 96px hero sizes; small print stays in a naskh-leaning body face for tashkeel legibility
never simulate weight by stroke (fake-bold breaks Arabic joins) — request the real Bold face
letter-spacing on Arabic >= 0.02em ONLY for display tracking; zero for body
mixed line: Latin runs isolated (bidi), digit set consistent (Arabic-Indic OR Western) declared in style.json.numeral_system
every entrance obeys arabic-type: shaped words, masks not letters
anti_monotony: A film where every line is same family+weight+size reads as template output even if motion is rich. motion_audit catches flat animation; THIS dictionary + review catch flat typography.
fetch: python3 tools/fetch_font.py --family 'Reem Kufi' --project <dir> — downloads ttf+LICENSE, records sha256 into assets/fonts/manifest.json
